description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of characteristics associated with a reasoning benchmark for Large Language Models. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different characteristic: “Complexity Instance” (blue), “Scalable Oversight” (red), “Auto-verifiable” (orange), “Coverage” (green), “General” (light green), and “Unhackable” (yellow). The “Complexity Instance” slice appears to represent approximately 25% of the chart, while “Scalable Oversight” and “Auto-verifiable” each occupy roughly 20%. “Coverage” takes up approximately 15%, “General” is around 10%, and “Unhackable” appears to represent approximately 10% of the chart. The chart includes labels positioned outside of each slice, and no percentage labels are displayed within the slices themselves. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, appearing to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
